search_audit.query: Unicode Unihan U+4EA1 kMandarin wáng U+5FD8 wàng official; 忘 亡 *maŋ-s perfective suffix Schuessler 2007 earliest attestation bronze; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 忘-seal.svg 亡-seal.svg 心-seal.svg
search_audit.outcome: Three distinct initial queries were run together. Search results did not provide direct, inspectable official readings for both characters or primary support for the perfective-suffix proposal. The exact Commons 忘 file page was opened and inspected.

Search did not locate the character-specific readings. Opened the official Unihan lookup service description and grid index; these confirm that the service holds character-level readings, but do not establish the exact two kMandarin values.

search_audit.query: Direct official Unihan record U+4EA1 and U+5FD8
search_audit.outcome: Both direct character-specific endpoint opens returned an access error in the web tool.

search_audit.query: Commons exact description pages for 忘-seal.svg, 亡-seal.svg and 心-seal.svg
search_audit.outcome: Opened and inspected the exact 忘 and 亡 description pages. 忘 is a modern seal-style redraw sourced to Hanziyuan S07737, with a public-domain SVG representation. 亡 is a separate modern redraw sourced to Hanziyuan S09433. The 亡 page lists further historical-style variants but those are not selected. 心 page opened, but no additional asset was needed. Direct 忘 image fetch was inaccessible via the web tool.

gaps: The review-requested current Mandarin comparison is supported by the provided exact local Unihan rows (亡 wáng; 忘 wàng) and local Baxter–Sagart rows (亡 OC *maŋ, MC mjang; 忘 OC *maŋ / *maŋ-s, MC mjang / mjangH). Those local files are not external evidence. Both official character-specific Unihan URLs were attempted but inaccessible in this run, so the exact current readings remain without verified official click-through evidence here.

No primary source establishing the proposed derivation of 忘 from 亡 with a perfective suffix was verified; no independent, dated attestations of the proposed source-word and suffixed use were examined. Treat that proposal as unresolved.

The seal-style 忘 image is an explicitly modern digital redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph; no visual inspection of its pixels was performed. Its description page provides identity, source attribution, direct original-file link and reuse statement, but its direct image URL could not be opened in the web tool.

No verified evidence in this follow-up establishes the earliest attested 忘 graph, a dated semantic-extension sequence, or a competing corruption analysis. The dossier’s earlier paleographic summary remains secondary and does not establish an oracle-bone occurrence.

It is useful as a later received-form illustration but does not establish the compound’s earliest form.
items.rights: Public domain for the SVG representation according to the exact Commons description page; modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The drawing is a modern redraw of a historical script style, not an ancient artifact image. The direct image URL could not be opened in the research tool, so pixel inspection was not performed. It does not establish the earliest form or date of 忘.
